summary: Mobile app background suspend causes SSE session thaw reorder and loss of terminal metadata
description:
Issue summary:
Customer ClariTech reports that when their iOS/Android app is backgrounded for >12s and then resumed, SSE streams frequently reconnect but the final 'terminal' metadata for responses is missing or duplicated, resulting in truncated JSON chunks and client-side parse errors. Impact: multiple end-user sessions see incomplete answers or repeated prefix text.

Impact:
- Several customers in the enterprise account experienced truncated model responses in the UI during mobile app resume flows.
- Affects chat and long-form generation routes using streaming SSE.

Environment:
- Customer mobile app (React Native wrapper + native WebView on Android 13 and iOS 16)
- Production Redwood hosted API, us-east region
- Customer using dedicated capacity with pinned model version

Observed behavior:
- App backgrounded ~15–90s, resumed -> client SDK performs incremental reconnect. Server accepts resume token but final 'end' metadata event (" + end-of-stream metadata + ") never delivered; downstream client eventually times out and attempts full reconnect which yields duplicate prefix tokens.

Expected behavior:
- Resume should reattach and deliver any missing terminal metadata or else perform a clean restart with no duplicated content.

Temporary workaround:
- Customer set SDK to disable resume-on-background (force full reconnect) and increased client-side reassembly timeout to 8s. This reduces truncations but increases perceived latency on resume.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Open ClariTech mobile app and start a streaming chat request to Redwood hosted endpoint (SSE enabled).
2) Wait for ~20s of streaming output to begin, then background the app (home button / screen lock).
3) Keep the app backgrounded for 15–90s (observed window).
4) Resume the app — SDK attempts transparent SSE resume using stored session token and sequence number.
5) Observe client logs: resume accepted but final terminal metadata event not emitted; client reassembly times out or later sees duplicated prefix after a fallback full reconnect.
logs: proxy: 200 resume OK -> upstream session id=us-east-7-AB12 seq=243
serving-runtime: missing terminal event detected - last-seen-seq=242; no terminal metadata after resume window
client: reassembly_timeout after 8500ms -> performing full reconnect
client: new_session token=rt_YYY seq=0 -> receives duplicate prefix tokens from seq 0..20
investigation_notes: 03/10 - initial triage by Support: reproduced with ClariTech build v3.4.1 on Android 13 emulator when using RN WebView keepalive/pause behavior.

03/11 - SRE/Serving looked at proxy logs: saw resume accept followed by no terminal event emission from worker; worker reports an in-memory session state flagged as 'thawed' but with pending terminal batch lost during OS-level socket suspension.

03/11 - Hypothesis: client-side background suspend causes TCP/OS stack to drop in-flight keepalive/FIN; intermediate transparent streaming proxy marks original connection stale and upstream worker performs partial flush and frees terminal metadata before client rebinds, so resume is accepted but terminal marker is gone.
03/11 - Additional discovery: client SDK monotonically increments seq before suspend in RN layer; on resume the SDK sends seq+1 which can cause off-by-one acceptance and duplicate prefix on fallback.

03/12 - Reproduced on prod-like staging with a mobile suspend harness; able to trigger missing terminal metadata consistently when background >12s and resume within a 60s window behind our Edge proxy.
comments: Support (Aisha): Logged initial report and requested full HAR and client SDK logs from customer. Asked them to try disabling resume-on-background as a short-term mitigation.
Customer (ClariTech - eng): Sent SDK logs and confirmed workaround reduced truncations but unacceptable UX (longer reconnect). Provided additional traces showing duplicate prefix after fallback.
SRE (Luca): Confirmed resume acceptance in edge logs with no terminal event emitted. Created a staging harness to reproduce using Android emulator. Marking for eng attention.

Eng (Marta R.): Identified that worker flush code treats socket tear as completion and frees terminal metadata if connection has no pending ACKs for >10s. Suggested we make terminal metadata persisted to resume log for 30s to allow client rebinds.

Eng (Luca): Proposing two-part fix: 1) server-side change to retain terminal metadata for short TTL post-flush and accept out-of-order resume within a delta window; 2) client SDK patch to avoid seq increment on suspend and to fall back faster to full reconnect without retransmitting prefix tokens.
Support (Aisha): Scheduled a coordinated release window with ClariTech for the SDK patch + server side change. Customer requested ETA and asked for rollback plan if latency increases.
SRE (Luca): Will roll server-side change to canary (staging -> 5% prod) and monitor stream-tail error rate and duplicate-prefix rate. SDK patch will be cut to customer as pre-release for testing.
resolution: In progress: mitigation applied (customer disabled resume-on-background). Engineering patch scoped: server will persist terminal metadata for 30s post-flush and accept resume with seq tolerance ±1; client SDK will be patched to avoid pre-suspend seq bump and quicker full-reconnect fallback. Plan: canary server change 03/13, SDK pre-release to ClariTech 03/13, full rollout pending canary metrics.
